stem: Which of the following describes all solutions to the inequality \(5(x - 2) \ge 8x + 11\)?
solution: Divide by \(-3\) and reverse the sign: \(x \le -7\). Check: \(x = -10\) gives \(-60 \ge -69\), true.

explanation.A: Incorrect. Dividing \(-3x \ge 21\) by \(-3\) reverses the inequality sign.
explanation.B: Incorrect. This distributes the 5 only to \(x\), using \(5x - 2\) instead of \(5x - 10\).
explanation.D: Incorrect. This drops the negative sign on both \(-3\) and 21; try \(x = 10\): \(40 \ge 91\) is false.

verify:
P = lambda s: value(s.replace('\\le', '<=').replace('\\ge', '>='))
x = symbols('x')
s = solve_univariate_inequality(5*(x - 2) >= 8*x + 11, x, relational=False)
assert s == Interval(-oo, -7)
assert solve_univariate_inequality(P(choices[answer]), x, relational=False) == s
assert all(solve_univariate_inequality(P(choices[k]), x, relational=False) != s for k in choices if k != answer)
